definitions.explanation: A small stick with cotton wrapped around one or both ends, used for cleaning ears, applying medicine or cosmetics, and other purposes.

examples.japanese: {綿棒|めんぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To clean one's ears with a cotton swab.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{綿棒|めんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きて。
examples.english: Go buy some cotton swabs at the pharmacy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{綿棒|めんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}とせる→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: You can cleanly remove dirt from small areas by using a cotton swab.

notes:
A common household item. Composed of ⟦{綿|めん}→綿：03807_men⟧ (cotton) + ⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧ (stick/rod). An everyday word that every learner living in Japan will encounter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {綿棒|めんぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{耳掃除|みみそうじ}: ear cleaning with a cotton swab
- {綿棒|めんぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply (medicine/cosmetics) with a cotton swab
- ⟦{使|つか}い{捨|す}て→使い捨て：07665_tsukaisute⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綿棒|めんぼう}: disposable cotton swabs
- ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧{綿棒|めんぼう}: cotton swabs with thin tips

USAGE:
While commonly used for ear cleaning in Japan, medical professionals often advise against inserting cotton swabs into the ear canal. {綿棒|めんぼう} is also used for applying medicine to wounds, cleaning small electronics, and precision cosmetics application.

RELATED WORDS:
- {耳掃除|みみそうじ}: ear cleaning
- ⟦{耳|みみ}かき→耳かき：16362_mimikaki⟧: ear pick — a traditional Japanese ear-cleaning tool, different from a cotton swab
- {脱脂綿|だっしめん}: absorbent cotton; cotton wool — the medical cotton used for gauze and padding
